messages:
sarah: Planning a small rotational fan-shift of EU->APAC routing tomorrow 09:00 UTC. This is a micro-window (10m steady-state), purpose is to validate the new route weight smoothing logic. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?
omar: I can run the deploy and watch the rollout steps. Will need someone in console to watch latency spikes and Kibana traces.
tess: I can cover observability (dashboards, alerts, traces). Will be around 08:45-10:30 UTC.
sarah: Thanks. Omar you'll execute the routing swap script and then apply the smoothing policy. Order: 1) reduce EU weight by 6% -> 2) wait 2m -> 3) apply smoothing -> 4) steady 10m -> 5) revert.
leo: Quick Q: do we need to touch DNS TTLs for this? I was assuming just routing policy changes at the edge (LB).
sarah: Correct — no DNS changes. This is routing policy only; TTLs remain. We will keep failure fallback to global-origin.
omar: Noted. I'll post the exact commands when I'm on. Will run from my laptop + jumpbox.
nana: typo — i'm ana, I'll be on-call for rollback steps if anything goes sideways.
nana: Add me to the thread in case we need a quick abort.
mike: I'll prep a canary check script for traffic correctness: checks per-region p99 latency, error-rate, and token-per-request cost delta. Will post a short runbook.
(mike posts) mike: Canary script (run from ci-tool):
```
./check_fan_shift.sh --window 120 --thresholds latency:400,error:0.5
```
Will output a small CSV and a pass/fail code.
sarah: Perfect. Omar, when you start, drop a short banner: who, what, start ts. Also make sure deploy-bot announces the route policy change.
deploy-bot: Route policy update queued by omar at 1765555000. Plan: EU weight -6% -> apply smoothing profile 'micro-fan-v2' -> steady 10m -> revert.
omar: Starting now. Step 1: apply EU -6%.
(redeploy logs) deploy-bot: Applied weight change. old: EU=62% new: EU=56%
tess: Observability: quick look — no large p50/p95 shifts, p99 small bump +12ms. Traces look normal, no new error spikes.
mike: Canary check passing (0 errors, p99 380ms). CSV uploaded to /tmp/fanshift-1765554321.csv
sarah: Good. Maintain steady for full 10m. Omar keep the thread updated every 2m. If mike or tess see >0.5% errors or p99>450ms, abort.
omar: 2m check: metrics stable.
leo: small note — frontend has a minor retry that might mask some errors; watch backend error rates in traces.
an a: oncall: I'm standing by. If we abort I'll execute the route revert and remove smoothing.
omar: Final steady check done, all green. Reverting to pre-change now.
deploy-bot: Reverted weights to EU=62% at 1765557890. Smoothing profile detached.
tess: Post-revert sanity: metrics returned to baseline. No residual elevated latencies.
sarah: Thanks team — great quick run. Follow-ups: update the rollout doc with 'micro-fan' steps and add the canary script link. I'll file a short post-mortem note (no incidents) and tag the console dashboard owner. :thumbsup:
